instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Custom furniture manufacturer crafting solid wood pieces for hospitality and high-end residential projects. Blend of CNC routing for repetitive components with traditional joinery for finishing. Evaluating digital twin assembly planning to reduce custom project lead times from 12 to 7 weeks. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 7 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Develop a Configurable Digital Twin Experience for Proactive Customer Engagement
opportunities.rationale: Customer churn is driven by poor self-service and product stagnation. Moving beyond simple digital catalogs, Quantum must offer an interactive tool that allows B2B clients to visualize bespoke pieces in their space (digital twin planning). This radical shift transforms the customer journey from reactive ordering to proactive design collaboration, directly addressing retention concerns.

first_actions: Define core parameters for the digital configurator using existing product SKUs and material libraries.
Pilot the tool with 5-10 key mid-tier clients to gather usage metrics and usability feedback.
Integrate initial planning module directly into the sales/CRM workflow (SFA).
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in qualified leads citing the digital tool during initial inquiry by 20%
milestones: Closed beta with internal sales team (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Formalize Intellectual Property (IP) Management and Design Standards
opportunities.rationale: As the company grows its portfolio of successful BUs and custom designs, founder knowledge becomes a single point of failure. Establishing formal IP guidelines and standardizing proprietary design elements ensures that institutional knowledge is captured and scalable, mitigating reliance on any single individual’s expertise.

first_actions: Audit existing unique designs/process improvements to identify patentable or copyrightable assets.
Draft a standardized IP contribution agreement for all new cross-functional teams (venture studio model).
Establish a centralized, accessible digital repository for design specifications and processes.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of the IP audit database covering 80% of critical product lines.
milestones: Audit Scope and Legal Counsel engaged (Month 2)
Drafted governance policy signed off by leadership (Month 4)
Repository fully populated with core assets (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Conduct deep-dive exit interview analysis to quantify the correlation between digital self-service gaps and product stagnation mentions.
Allocate limited budget for a proof-of-concept technical scoping exercise on the digital twin configurator to validate feasibility and required external resources.
Define clear, non-negotiable functional boundaries for the founder's time to ensure they can dedicate structured blocks of time solely to strategy and oversight, rather than daily execution.

key_weaknesses: Severe dependency on the founder's bandwidth for strategic decision-making and technical oversight.
Current digital offerings fail to meet modern B2B customer expectations, leading directly to churn.
Insufficient formal process (IP management) to scale proprietary designs beyond individual knowledge.

improvements: Increased Digital Maturity: The successful launch of the inventory digitalization project and the general focus on cross-functional digital initiatives show improved operational awareness.
Process Success: The internal venture studio model remains robust, proving Quantum’s capacity to manage multiple innovation streams simultaneously.
persistent_gaps: Lack of structured delegation means process improvements often stall when the founder is occupied with core operations.
The current operational focus (supply chain fixes) continues to divert critical resources and attention away from strategic market defense initiatives.
Strategic barriers remain high; securing necessary specialized technical talent or capital for radical shifts remains difficult.
achieved_milestones: Inventory digitalization project launched, providing better visibility into supply chain constraints.
One incubated venture unit successfully graduated to standalone business status, validating the internal studio model's potential.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Digital maturity has increased (3 to 4), showing positive operational adoption despite persistent margin pressure. Crucially, while internal process capability remains high, the primary strategic challenge has sharpened: moving from 'product stagnation' as a risk to quantifiable 'customer churn' as an acute crisis.
